mapper.sql: p.id, p.slug, p.title, p.excerpt, p.content, p.cover_from, p.cover_to, p.cover_image, p.views, p.pinned, p.status, p.published_at, p.updated_at, c.slug AS category_slug, c.name AS category_name, c.description AS category_description

sql.if: AND ( p.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.slug LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.excerpt LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE 1 = 1

SELECT
FROM post p LEFT JOIN category c ON c.id = p.category_id WHERE p.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET slug = #{slug}, title = #{title}, excerpt = #{excerpt}, content = #{content}, cover_from = #{coverFrom}, cover_to = #{coverTo}, cover_image = #{coverImage}, category_id = #{categoryId}, status = #{status}, pinned = #{pinned}, published_at = #{publishedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT t.slug FROM post_tag pt JOIN tag t ON t.id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.post_id = #{postId} ORDER BY t.name ASC
